title: Evaluating AI Musical Creativity: Towards a Quantitative Multi-Dimensional Framework Based on Value, Novelty, and Surprise
abstract: arXiv:2611.14634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the increasing sophistication of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), research on the evaluation of AI-generated musical creativity remains limited. To address this gap, this paper proposes a quantitative framework for the formalization and evaluation of AI musical creativity. Building on Margaret Boden's theory, which conceptualizes creativity in terms of value, novelty, and surprise, the framework adapts and operationalizes these three dimensions for the musical domain. On the hypothesis that certain aspects of musical creativity can be assessed with a degree of objectivity, a domain-specific set of quantitative metrics for evaluating the creativity of AI-generated music is introduced. translated_title: 评估AI音乐创造力：迈向基于价值、新颖性与惊喜的量化多维度框架
translated_abstract: 尽管生成式人工智能日益成熟，但关于AI生成音乐创造力评估的研究仍然有限。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一个用于AI音乐创造力形式化与评估的量化框架。该框架建立在Margaret Boden的理论基础上——该理论从价值、新颖性和惊喜三个维度来界定创造力——并将这三个维度适配到音乐领域并加以可操作化。基于音乐创造力的某些方面可以在一定程度上被客观评估这一假设，本文引入了一套针对音乐领域特性的量化指标，用于评估AI生成音乐的创造力。本文并非将音乐创造力简化为单一的统一衡量标准，而是提出了一组互补的指标集合来捕捉其不同维度，承认了音乐作品的复杂性以及定义（音乐创造力）的困难。
tldr: 本文基于Margaret Boden的价值、新颖性与惊喜三维度创造力理论，提出了一个由多个互补的领域特定量化指标构成的评估框架，用以对AI生成音乐的创造力进行相对客观的多维度量化评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quantitative multi-dimensional framework, grounded in Boden's theory of value, novelty, and surprise, that employs an ensemble of complementary domain-specific metrics to objectively evaluate the creativity of AI-generated music.
